$comment: Everything that can be bought on the site, paid through Stripe Checkout (prices in Australian cents: 2300 = A$23.00). PLACEHOLDERS: every ticket type, price, capacity and merch item below is invented for layout and must be replaced before sales open (marked TBC). `sku` must be unique and must never change once something has been sold (orders keep it). Tickets: `onSale` is the default; the hidden admin page can switch sales on/off per event without a rebuild. `capacity` is the most that can ever be sold (null = no limit). `admissions` (default 1): how many QR tickets one purchase issues (a 3-day pass = 3). Merch: `variants` (e.g. sizes) each have their own sku and stock. `media` keys refer to media.json. `sfc.entryFee`: the Short Film Competition entry fee per film; submissions are open between `sfc.opens` and `sfc.closes` (inclusive, Melbourne time) unless the admin page overrides it.
